title: Mana, stages and affinity
text: Mana is your life force. Spending it all shocks you at 5% and blacks you out at 0.5%. Your Stage runs from 9 (junior) to 0 (Wizard King): a higher stage makes spells cheaper and stronger. Affinity (/multiverse mana affinity) trades 10% cost for 10% speed: loved = cheaper but slower, hated = dearer but quicker. The Mana Zone page lets you tap the mana around you for 30 s: cheaper and stronger spells, light on your feet. Thick-mana places (deep ocean, Nether, mountains, End, Grand Magic Zones) make it stronger. The Magic Stone gives 60 s of negative mana: +60% power, -30% cost, but every cast corrupts you.
